attention.why: rank-3 (B, L, C) entry: inserting the spatial axis at 0 makes the batch the H axis, so VaeAttention's reshape([n, 1, h*w, c]) flattens all B samples into ONE attention sequence; inserting it at 1 gives (B, 1, L, C) and keeps the samples independent
the matching exit for the rank-3 path: drop the inserted spatial axis, not the batch axis
